meta.name: Yeh Meri Family 720p
meta.description:
Set in the summer of 1998 it is a story about conflicting emotions towards family members from the eyes of a twelve year old.

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7 | S2 5/5 | S3 5/5 | S4 5/5

videos.title: Pukam Pukai
videos.overview: All Harshu wants is all any 12-year-old does, to play and have fun with his best friend Shanky during the summer vacations, but mom has different plans for him.

videos.title: Vish Amrit
videos.overview: Birthday is one day that gets every 12-year old excited and Harshu is no different. Harshu and Shanky have big plans for Harshu's birthday, but mom has a sweet surprise planned for him.

videos.title: The 12th Man
videos.overview: The dreaded day of results in school is here, but Harshu isn't worried about the report card. What's bothering him is his Papa coming to school for the open day.

videos.title: Posham Pa
videos.overview: Harshu discovers some secrets about his elder brother Dabbu and realizes he is not as innocent as he seems. Things get unpleasant at home and Harshu soon learns that this is more than just a trump card battle.

videos.title: Kacchi Ghodi
videos.overview: When the parents have an intense fight, the entire house is on high alert. While Harshu and Dabbu try to calm things down, the adorable little sister, Chitti goes missing.

videos.title: Chupan Chupai
videos.overview: Harshu never gives up an opportunity to try to impress his crush Vidhya. His best friend Shanky gives him new tips and tricks to grab her attention, but this time Harshu has his own plans.

videos.title: Chiddiya Ud
videos.overview: No matter how much we fight with our siblings, how much we hit them, we can't stay away from them. Similar is the story of Harshu and his brother Dabbu.

videos.title: Apna Kamra
videos.overview: 15-year-old Ritika, amidst the chaos of the Awasthi family, feels the need to have a room of her own. But an unexpected visit from a family guest drastically disturbs her plan.

videos.title: Party
videos.overview: It’s the new year. Ritika wants to meet her crush. Yet, the seemingly charming boy breaks her heart. On top of her secrecy is about to get disclosed when an unexpected turn of events shows her a way out.

videos.title: Cable TV
videos.overview: As Ritika voluntarily becomes the caretaker of the family, with her mother ill, fear of exams come knocking her down. Will she find an unexpected savior?

videos.title: Parent Teacher Meeting
videos.overview: The PTM takes an unexpected turn when Ritika’s mother, a teacher is accused of having children unworthy of a respectable school - teacher. Rishi and Ritika decide to prove they are worthy. There comes a moment where Ritika has to choose between her ambition and that of her younger brother.

videos.title: Blank Call
videos.overview: Ritika has a secret admirer. He crosses a line. She is in a situation where she does not feel comfortable in launching a complaint. A helping hand comes from a direction that Ritika could never have imagined.

videos.title: Same Pinch!
videos.overview: Ritika's friend Shubhi visits the Awasthis. Rishi can't help but get smitten by her. Ritika devises a plan to know his true intentions.

videos.title: Holi
videos.overview: Rishi and Ritika have big plans for Holi. But Neerja is concerned about Ritika’s exam which falls on the next day.

videos.title: Tit For Tat
videos.overview: Rishi gets bullied in school. Ritika helps Rishi teach the bully a lesson, but the siblings end up getting into trouble.

videos.title: Happy Birthday
videos.overview: It’s Sanjay’s birthday. Neerja and the kids have a surprise planned, but Dadi is planning to celebrate the special day in her own way. Sanjay is stuck between his wife and kids, and his mother.

videos.title: Moonchh
videos.overview: Sanjay’s older brother visits the family. Sanjay is made to realize that he is not strict enough with his children.

videos.title: Independence Day
videos.overview: Rishi and Ritika finally gain independence from their controlling parents, as Neerja, Sanjay and Dadi have to visit bade papa due to an emergency. But then come clouds of rain and unexpected problems.

videos.title: Manglu
videos.overview: The siblings are at war as Raksha Bandhan is around the corner. But when Ritika brings an abandoned puppy home, the kids have to come together to keep it a secret.

videos.title: Bhai Ho To Aisa
videos.overview: Bade papa’s son Ashu is here to stay at Awasthi Niwas. Rishi is thrilled to finally have an elder brother as he always desired. However, Ashu is not who he seems to be. Ritika is concerned.

videos.title: Heels
videos.overview: Ritika wants heels but no one is ready to fulfill her wish. In her efforts to get a pair, she ends up crossing a line. Ritika has to find balance between her desire, self esteem and family values.

videos.title: Dosti = Pyaar?
videos.overview: While Neerja and Sanjay worry about Ritika’s fast approaching board exams, a new friendship brews between her and a new boy in class.
